gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed diagnosis of a recurrent/progressive WHO grade IV malignant gliomas (glioblastoma) and meet the following inclusion criteria:
ERC1671 to Treat Malignant Gliomas When Given in Combination With GM-CSF, Cyclophosphamide, Bevacizumab and Pembrolizumab

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a treatment clinical trial to assess the efficacy of ERC1671 in combination with bevacizumab and pembrolizumab in patients with GBM that has progressed following treatment with radiation and temozolomide.
A therapeutic antibody that binds to and blocks PD-1 located on lymphocytes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First, second, third or fourth relapse of glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: ERC1671 is an autologous and allogeneic cells and lysates suspension generated from human glioblastoma (GBM) tumors harvested from patients undergoing surgery for glioblastoma.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous/allogeneic tumour cell and lysate cancer vaccine

role_evidence.quote: A therapeutic antibody that binds to and blocks PD-1 located on lymphocytes.
Sargramostim (Leukomax®, Leukine®); yeast-derived, recombinant human granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor (rhu GM-CSF)
Cyclophosphamide is an alkylating agent, used for immunopotentiation.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent used for immunopotentiation/immune modulation

role_evidence.quote: Patients will be treated with recurring 28-day cycles of ERC1671, GM-CSF, Cyclophosphomide, Bevacizumab, and Pembrolizumab until progression of disease and at the discretion of the treating physician.

coder_notes: Bevacizumab is not a registered intervention but is in the title, brief summary and arm description for every patient, so listed (soc_backbone, established GBM therapy given in all of the single arm). Pembrolizumab coded as the only investigational pharmacological agent alongside the vaccine (judgement: record frames the trial as ERC1671 efficacy combined with pembrolizumab; no separate pembrolizumab hypothesis stated). GM-CSF (vaccine adjuvant) and cyclophosphamide (immunopotentiation) coded supportive as no direct antitumour hypothesis is stated; adjudicator may disagree. Condition is 'Glioma, Malignant' but inclusion criteria require WHO grade IV glioblastoma.
